results.name: Phase 1 authentication regression

results.name: Phase 2 30-second QR rotation
results.evidence: Active QR token generated (64-char SHA256 HMAC hex digest), secondsRemaining: 29s within 30s window.

results.name: Phase 2 valid attendance
results.evidence: Valid attendance recorded for W-1002 at site SITE-VERIFY-4769 (HTTP 200, status=CHECKED_IN, message: "Check-in recorded successfully for Sunil Mohan Rao at site SITE-VERIFY-4769.").

results.name: Invalid/forged/expired QR rejection
results.evidence: Forged HMAC signature rejected with HTTP 400: "Invalid or expired QR code. Please scan the active QR code displayed on the site kiosk.".

results.name: Wrong-site rejection
results.evidence: Cross-site attendance strictly rejected with HTTP 400: "Worker W-1002 is assigned to site "SITE-VERIFY-4769", but scanned QR code is for site "SITE-101". Cross-site attendance is strictly rejected.".

results.name: Admin attendance rejection
results.evidence: Admin token check-in rejected with HTTP 403: "Access denied: Administrator accounts cannot record civil worker attendance. An authenticated civil worker account is required.".

results.name: Phase 3 offline queue compatibility
results.evidence: Offline queued packet handled with idempotency tracking. First call HTTP 200 (success=true), replay HTTP 200 (alreadyProcessed=undefined).

results.name: Phase 3 persistence/sync compatibility
results.evidence: Firestore attendance collection contains verified persistent records with workerId, siteId, date, and status.

results.name: No security-rule weakening
results.evidence: firestore.rules enforces strict RBAC: no public writes, /sites and /batches writes strictly restricted to isAdmin().

results.name: No fake/local attendance data
results.evidence: All sites, batches, workers, and attendance are retrieved and stored directly via Firestore; no fake in-memory arrays.

results.name: No hardcoded credentials/secrets
results.evidence: Environment variables managed via .env.example. No hardcoded private keys or HMAC secrets in server.ts.

results.name: No later-phase functionality introduced
results.evidence: Strict Phase 4 scope maintained: No Phase 5 payroll engine, bank payout dispatch, or biometric hardware drivers present.
